999008199.text: ここが終点みたいね

localizations.en: Looks like we've reached the end.

999008199.text:
うわ、なんか、そ、ソー……なんだっけ、
神秘的みたいな、でもちょっと怖いような

localizations.en: Whoa, this place is... sol... sol... what's the word? Mystical? But also kind of eerie?

999008199.text: 荘厳な雰囲気？
それ！

九偉人を崇拝する人々にとっての聖地だからな……
周りにあるのは捧げものか？

localizations.en: It makes sense—this is a sacred site for those who revere the Nine. Are those offerings around the altar?

999008199.text:
そんな、お祈りとかするほどのもんじゃないわよ。
九偉人なんてさ

localizations.en: I mean, they're not really worth praying to or anything. The Nine, I mean.

999008199.text:
ヴァレリアを見てると、九偉人だって
普通の人たちと変わんないもんね

localizations.en: Spending time with Valeria really does make them feel like regular people, doesn't it?

999008199.text: でしょ？　私だってそのつもりなのに

localizations.en: Exactly! That's all I'm trying to say.

999008199.text:
実際、九偉人が人間離れした強さを持ってるのも
確かだからね

localizations.en: Though it's just as true that they possess strength beyond anything human.

999008199.text:
人は自分の持ってないものに憧れ、羨み、恐れる……
少なくともここの人たちは、九偉人に救いを見たんだよ

localizations.en: People tend to revere what they can't have, or fear what they don't understand... At least the people here found hope in the Nine.

999008199.text:
……やっぱり実感が湧かないのは、
私の記憶が戻らないせいなのかしら

localizations.en: ...I wonder if the reason I can't quite grasp any of this is because my memories still haven't come back.

999008199.text:
ねえ、あの真ん中にある、他より高い所！
あそこにあるのって……

localizations.en: Hey, look at that raised platform in the center—it's higher than everything else! Is that...?

999008199.text:
「九偉人図」！
最後の１枚だ！！

localizations.en: A Portrait of the Nine! The last one!!

999008199.text:
こういうとき、冒険譚ならそれを阻む
凶悪な魔物が出てくるものだけど……

localizations.en: Now, in any good adventure tale, this is exactly where a fearsome monster would appear to block our path...

999008199.text: 大丈夫みたいね。さっきのヤツが最後だったみたい

localizations.en: But it seems we're in the clear. That last one really was the final monster.

999008199.text:
ま、用心するに越したことはないし、
そーっと、そーっと……

localizations.en: Still, no harm in being careful. Easy does it... nice and slow...

999008199.text:
よし……！
揃った！

localizations.en: Got it...! We have them all!

999008199.text:
と、ここで洞窟全体が鳴動、
落盤で出口が塞がれる！

localizations.en: And then the whole cave begins to shake—a rockslide seals the exit!

999008199.text: え、ええっ！？
……というのも、お話の中だけね

localizations.en: ...That's how the story would go, anyway.

999008199.text:
ビビッたぁ……
王女を驚かせようなんて、あなた肝が据わってるね！

localizations.en: You nearly gave me a heart attack... You've got some nerve, scaring a princess like that!

999008199.text: お母さん、ほんと程々にね……？

……よし！　とにもかくにも手に入れた「九偉人図」。
全部まとめて確認してみましょう！

localizations.en: ...Okay! One way or another, we have all the Portraits of the Nine. Let's lay them all out and see what they tell us!
